_about: The registry the release gate (tools/release_gate.py) reads. What gates is what CAN be solved: `open` (reading the vendor's app, another source or PairFree's own code, or building, can settle it) refuses a release that touches the brand, unless the owner waived it in data/release_waivers.json. What cannot be solved by reading is noted and does not gate, but must carry its proof (owner, 2026-11-21): `needs-report` (only a user's report or other outside information settles it: `needs` says what to ask for), `blocked` (a hard rule: `rule`), `not-applicable` (the vendor's app has no such control); each lists `read` (paths read, with what they showed) and `evidence` (searches over the app's files that the gate runs again; a needs-report item needs one with `expect: some` that finds the code in question). `built` is done. Add an item as soon as a post, a report or an audit shows a gap, set it to built in the change that builds it, and never settle an item as impossible without having read the code.

items.what: Issue #58: after a disconnect the earbuds are in the standard connection mode while PairFree shows the last choice. Read: Life sets the mode only from two screens and never on connecting; PairFree opens a new session for every channel and reads the mode (006C) first, and keeps the last state on screen only while the channel is being reopened. So either the earbuds answer 01 while they play in standard mode, or the read did not arrive; the code cannot tell which.

Smart Control Plus decides at run time: the function that builds a GAIA 3 equalizer variant takes the set of capabilities (parametricEqualizer, graphicalEqualizer, bassBoost) that another function builds from what the headphones report (their audio modes, among others); there is no per-product table to read.

Unread on every model: the wizard's other pages (the sealing and noise checks before the test, the report screen) and what the earbuds do with the hearing test mode on.

items.what: The ear canal test (EAR_CANAL_TESTING) is an ANC user trigger: AncStageStartAncUserTrigger (RACE 0901 with module 5) drives AirohaAncUserTriggerStateMachine (about 1500 lines, with relays to the other earbud and per-step RACE exchanges) from a ut_para.txt that AirohaDeviceStatusControl unzips from the app's EarCanalTesting.zip asset for the model, and reports the status as done (0 to 4) or failed (17). Not read beyond the stage and the flow; the state machine, the parameter file's use and what the test writes into the earbuds are unread.
